select ct.model, o.object_pk, o.user_id as who, 'u' as kind, p.codename from guardian_userobjectpermission o join auth_permission p on p.id = o.permission_id join django_content_type ct on ct.id = o.content_type_id union all select ct.model, o.object_pk, o.group_id, 'g', p.codename from guardian_groupobjectpermission o join auth_permission p on p.id = o.permission_id join django_content_type ct on ct.id = o.content_type_id order by 1, 2, 4, 3, 5

select l.id, l.action, ct.app_label || '.' || ct.model as model, l.object_pk, l.object_id, l.object_repr, l.changes, l.changes_text, l.actor_id, l.remote_addr, l.additional_data, l.timestamp, l.cid is not null as has_cid, l.actor_email, l.serialized_data from auditlog_logentry l join django_content_type ct on ct.id = l.content_type_id where l.id > 918 order by l.id
